cacheProtocol: First then warm replay of every arm in one shared extractor cache; initial calls can hit preceding arm cache. Every warm run asserts extractor calls=0 and exact equality of initial/warm metrics.
limitations: No live calls or human-audited gold. Construction component metrics do not establish task-success or production-default superiority.
Delivery, OM and tool-only variants may transform source without exercising that path; per-arm exercise notes identify these limits.
Capacity sweep varies per-scope note limits while retaining shipped token limits; protected notes can exceed capacity.
